description: This file defines the FilesystemLoader class for the Twig templating engine, responsible for loading templates from the filesystem. It includes methods for managing template paths, retrieving template content, and resolving template locations.

classes.name: FilesystemLoader
classes.description: Loads Twig templates from the filesystem, managing multiple template directories and namespaces.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with template paths and an optional root path.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of template paths for a specific namespace.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns all registered template namespace identifiers.

methods.name: setPaths
methods.description: Sets multiple paths for a given namespace.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new directory to the list of paths for template loading.

methods.name: prependPath
methods.description: Prepend a directory to the list of paths for a specific namespace.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source code of a template given its name.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for a template based on its path.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is up to date relative to a timestamp.
